reduce_vgpr_reload_lds.description: Reduce VGPR by reloading data from LDS per iteration instead of persistent registers

warp_tile_lds_coupling.description: When changing warp tile dimensions, always update the matching LDS descriptor and block dims

agpr_mfma_pinning.description: Use __builtin_amdgcn_mfma_* + asm volatile('+v'(c)) for AGPR pinning, never '+a' asm

sparse_block_m_128_guard.description: Sparse attention requires BLOCK_M=128; BLOCK_M=64 causes silent data corruption

conditional_save_for_backward.description: Skip save_for_backward tensors when gradient is not needed — saves 10+ ms per layer

mla_multi_pass_q_amortize_kv.description: Process multiple Q head batches (Q_PASSES) per KV tile load to amortize KV memory traffic

mla_vectorized_kv_load.description: Use uint4 (dwordx4 = 16 bytes) vectorized loads for KV global→LDS transfer

mla_online_softmax_with_lse.description: Two-stage online softmax: per-split tracking (Stage 1) + cross-split reduction via LSE (Stage 2)

moe_gemm0_gemm1_fusion.description: Fuse MoE gate (X.G^T) and up (X.U^T) GEMMs into one TG, sharing a single X load to halve X HBM traffic

moe_blockscale_dpp_dequant.description: Apply 128x128 FP8 block scales to an MFMA accumulator in-register by DPP-broadcasting one lane's scale across the block

moe_k_split_dual_stream.description: Split the K loop into two halves (K=0..3 and K=4..7) with independent load/MFMA cadences to hide weight HBM latency

moe_register_aliasing.description: Alias _v_G/_v_U weight VGPR windows across GEMM phases and reuse MFMA A-operand range as MAX-reduction scratch to stay under VGPR budget

moe_lds_x_reuse.description: Stage X tile once into LDS during GEMM0, then consume it from LDS in GEMM1 to halve X HBM traffic in fused MoE gate+up

moe_memory_bound_weight_dominant.description: Fused MoE is memory-bound with weights at 99% of bytes; only weight-traffic-reducing optimizations move E2E

moe_cache_thrashing_past_batch_480.description: fmoe HBM BW collapses from 4.05 to 0.71 TB/s as batch grows 480->8613 due to L2 thrashing; optimize the 480-1547 regime

tilelang_gemm_no_sliced_operands.description: TileLang T.gemm rejects sliced shared-memory operands ('bad optional access' in LayoutInference). Pre-copy chunks into small scratch buffers via T.copy, then T.gemm on the full scratch.

amdahl_prioritize_by_p.description: Rank candidates by fraction-of-total-time (P), not local win potential; reject candidates with <1% E2E even at 2x local

roofline_use_maf_not_peak.description: Use MAF (~50% of vendor peak) for roofline denominator: MI300X/MI325X bf16=650 fp8=1300; MI355X bf16=1260 fp8=2500 TFLOPs

mfma_16x16x128_f8f6f4_fp4_operand_layout.description: Per-lane operand layout for v_mfma_scale_f32_16x16x128_f8f6f4 cbsz=0 blgp=4 (FP8 A x FP4 B): FP4 B is NATURAL (lane k_lane reads contiguous 16 bytes covering K=[k_lane*32, +32)); FP8 A is PERMUTED (lane k_lane reads bytes [k_lane*16, +16) AND [k_lane*16+64, +16), NON-CONTIGUOUS). Per AMD CDNA4 ISA pages 51, 65. Single-MFMA tests with sum-invariant patterns are NECESSARY but NOT SUFFICIENT - use a K-position probe (k%16, k/16 two-probe). For Stage B-style turbo kernels: buffer_load_lds<16> requires lane-uniform LDS stride (lane L writes base + L*Bytes), so padding FP4 B to 128-byte LDS rows for swizzle reuse is BROKEN — use 64-byte rows instead (4 ds_read_b128 per subtile vs Stage B's 8).
mfma_16x16x128_f8f6f4_fp4_operand_layout.confidence: MEDIUM (3 applications: native baseline 660 TF, turbo M1 1146 TF, dequant 1338 TF)
